name: @raea/godot
description: Godot's whole API from TypeScript through GodotJS (MIT): Godot 4.6.1's classes, singletons, enums and builtins, typed from GodotJS's codegen (tools/gen.sh), run by `raea godot run` in the Godot raea setup godot installs, on Godot's own JavaScript engine (JavaScriptCore on the Mac, QuickJS on Windows and Linux).
